description:
Get a list of the customTaskExtension objects and their properties.

TIP: Lists custom task extensions for lifecycle workflows. These are Logic App-based custom actions that can be added to workflow steps. Each has displayName, endpointConfiguration, callbackConfiguration, and createdDateTime.
